# Zeus AI

> Zeus AI is your personal AI coding guru — a patient, multilingual programming mentor that teaches developers from absolute beginner to advanced engineer.

Zeus AI explains concepts step-by-step, debugs code, mentors real projects, and prepares engineers for interviews. It adapts to each learner's level across 20+ programming languages.
